title: Count Transactions per Visit
learning_objective: Learn how to count transaction rows per visit.

tutorial.explanation: COUNT with GROUP BY converts many transaction rows into one count per visit.
tutorial.syntax: SELECT visit_id, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactions GROUP BY visit_id;
tutorial.mental_model: Each visit_id becomes a bucket. COUNT measures how many transaction rows landed in that bucket.

guided_example.solution_query: SELECT visit_id, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactions GROUP BY visit_id;
guided_example.explanation: Grouping by visit_id gives one row per visit with its transaction count.

practice.prompt: Return visit_id and total amount for each visit.
practice.expected_query: SELECT visit_id, SUM(amount) AS total_amount FROM transactions GROUP BY visit_id;
